messages.content: You are the Stage 2 dispatcher. Given a Stage 1b CausalSpec, route each indicator down the computed path (deterministic Polars aggregation on a single source column) or the semantic path (LLM fan-out workers reading text source columns). Compile per-window aggregations; emit ObservationRecord rows.
Route the 24 indicators. Apply support-window aggregations against the Stage 0 parquet and emit observation records. model_clock = 1d.

Routing: 18 indicators → computed path (single source_column → daily Polars aggregation, deterministic). 6 indicators → semantic path (require LLM interpretation of free-text or short-categorical source content). Dispatching 4 parallel semantic workers: worker 0 extracts journal_affect_severity over 20 entry-days, worker 1 extracts journal_rumination_intensity over the same 20 days, worker 2 extracts gp_clinical_severity over the 5 GP visit days, worker 3 classifies all calendar events into social/medical/acute_stressor counts over the 369-day calendar coverage. Computed path emits 19,096 rows; semantic path emits 535 rows.
messages.reasoning: The semantic indicators land where the LLM actually adds value: (a) journal-text affect ratings — prose is too rich to summarize via word counts alone; the same word count of 80 means very different things in the Oct-19-2023 'workhole' entry vs the Apr-08-2023 'olive bowl pending' entry. (b) GP clinical-severity — clinician-implied severity from HPI + Assessment text is a useful second channel beyond the patient-rated PHQ-9. (c) Calendar event classification — 'Helen' (therapist), 'Lex' (med reminder, already excluded), 'Dr. Patel', 'Mom 6' (Mom's 66th birthday), 'Brooklyn Boulders' all need domain knowledge. Workers 0 and 1 share the same 20 entry-days but with different extraction prompts, so each reads the entry text once. Worker 2 has 5 chunks of HPI text (~200-400 words each). Worker 3 chunks calendar days into 100-day batches, reads the concatenated event text per day, and applies the social/medical/acute_stressor taxonomy from the Stage 1b how_to_measure instructions. All extractions validated against measurement_dtype: ordinal codes for journal_affect_severity in [0,4], continuous for rumination_intensity and gp_clinical_severity, count for the three calendar-classification indicators.

messages.content: VALID — 19,631 extractions across 23 emitting indicators (24 declared; late_refill_count emits 0); all (window_start, indicator) pairs unique; all values dtype-conformant (ordinal codes within bounds, continuous in expected ranges, counts non-negative); all support_window starts on the daily grid.

Stage 2 complete. 19,631 ObservationRecord rows persisted to stage2-raw-data.parquet and stage2-model-data.parquet. 19,096 from computed path (4 cores, ~5s), 535 from semantic path (4 LLM workers, ~38s). Stage 3 (extraction validation) consumes this directly.
